tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Search for pickup or destination places. Use resolve_place on the selected result before planning a trip.

tools.name: resolve_place
tools.description: Resolve a place ID from search_places to an exact name, address, and coordinates.

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Compare ride-hailing with public transport: trotro in Ghana, or buses leaving now in England, Scotland and Wales. This is the default tool for multimodal trip planning.

tools.name: compare_rides
tools.description: Compare current ride-hailing prices and pickup times from the providers available through Sail.

tools.name: plan_public_transport
tools.description: Plan public transport with fares, walking legs, transfers, and boarding instructions: trotro in Ghana, or buses leaving now in England, Scotland and Wales. Bus times come from published timetables, not live tracking.

tools.name: plan_trotro_route
tools.description: Plan trotro journeys in Ghana, including fares, walking legs, transfers, and boarding instructions. Prefer plan_public_transport, which also covers buses in Great Britain.
